scenario: Let referencing a later let (forward reference) is rejected per LLET.12.3 — let bindings are ordered; only earlier lets / pattern bindings / consts / companion slots are visible.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    let x = y + 1
    let y = t.v
    log info "x"
